en.headline: Hong Kong WinterFest opens with winter wonderlands in Central and Tsim Sha Tsui
en.dek: The Hong Kong Tourism Board’s annual festival began on 18 November with light installations and a Christmas town at Statue Square, running through 5 January.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board launched its annual Hong Kong WinterFest on 18 November, expanding the Hong Kong Winter Wonderland programme to three locations for the first time.

In Central, Statue Square Gardens hosts a Christmas Town around a 22-metre tree, with interactive booths and a 360-degree light and sound show. The Tsim Sha Tsui site, sponsored by Prudential, features dynamic light installations and projections along the harbour promenade.

A third Winter Wonderland in Causeway Bay, covering the Lee Gardens area with a night parade and markets, is scheduled to open on 25 November. The overall festival runs until 5 January 2027, according to the Tourism Board.
Visitors can check the Board’s official pages for opening hours, which vary by weekday and weekend, and for any updates on special arrangements around the year-end holidays.

zh.headline: 香港冬日節開幕 中環及尖沙咀冬日仙境亮相
zh.dek: 旅發局年度旗艦活動「香港冬日節」于11月18日開幕，香港冬日仙境首次擴展至三大熱點，展期至明年1月5日。
body: 香港旅遊發展局於11月18日推出年度旗艦活動「香港冬日節」，將「香港冬日仙境」首次擴展至三個主要旅遊點。
中環皇后像廣場以高達22米的聖誕樹為中心，設有聖誕小鎮、互動摊位及360度光影聲效表演。尖沙咀海濱長廊則由保誠贊助，以動態光影裝置及投影為主。
銅鑼灣利園一帶的第三個冬日仙境定於11月25日開幕，將有夜間巡遊及市集。整個節慶活動持續至明年1月5日。
市民可流覽旅發局官方頁面，查閱各區開放時間及年底特別安排的最新資料。
